summary: First iteration end-to-end frontend testing of Sankalp Group Business Management System (frontend-only, Supabase direct). Login, dashboard KPIs, admin role badge, sidebar navigation incl. admin-only Team/Approvals, Leads CRUD (create form, table + kanban views, status change via dropdown), Request Delete with 'Delete pending' tag, Approvals page listing the pending lead, navigation to Customers/Receipts/Projects/Vendors/Team pages, and logout were all verified working against the public preview URL using the admin credentials info.subhendu@gmail.com / Subhendu8958@. Supabase auth + RLS + table access work. Did NOT exhaustively cover: lead-to-customer conversion, customer create dialog submit, receipt creation/SG-XXXXX numbering/print page, project create + add expense + profit-loss calc, vendor + record payment dialogs, approve/reject buttons on Approvals, role change on Team — these page shells load successfully but their internal create/submit dialogs were not all submitted end-to-end. Recommend main agent self-test those remaining dialog submissions; UI shell is sound and Supabase wiring is healthy.

issues: Radix Dialog accessibility console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Non-blocking but should add DialogDescription for a11y.

action_items: Add <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby) to all Shadcn DialogContent instances to silence Radix a11y warning.

Main agent should self-verify: (1) Lead → Convert to Customer creates customer + locks lead, (2) New Customer dialog submission, (3) New Receipt creates receipt_no in SG-XXXXX pattern and /receipts/:id/print renders amount-in-words, (4) New Project + Add Expense by category + profit/loss math on project detail page, (5) New Vendor + Record Payment dialogs persist, (6) Approvals Approve/Reject buttons work, (7) Team page role toggle admin↔rm. UI shells for each of these pages all load correctly so testing should be straightforward.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.jsx: onAuthStateChange callback does not await loadProfile inside an `if (mounted)` guard — could call setState after unmount on tab switch; minor.

DashboardPage useEffect dependency array is empty but uses todayISO() — fine since component re-mounts on route change, but stats won't auto-refresh after creating leads/receipts in the same session unless user navigates away and back. Consider exposing a refresh trigger.
LeadsPage handleConvert / handleRequestDelete use window.confirm() instead of Shadcn AlertDialog — works but inconsistent with the rest of the brutalist UI style.
Several DialogContent components miss DialogDescription (a11y warning).
Files are well within size budgets; service layer is cleanly separated.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all tested flows passed; some dialog submits not exercised end-to-end)
